messages.content: "situationship" আর "friends with benefits" এর মধ্যে পার্থক্য কী?

Situationship e romantic feeling/exclusivity thakte pare kintu label define kora nai, physical ekta part hote pare abar nao hote pare. FWB shomanyoto physical e limited thake, romantic commitment expect kora hoy na - clearer boundary thake ekhane.
